newsitem.title: JAPAN: Electric Power's coal power plant begins test run.
newsitem.headline: Electric Power's coal power plant begins test run.

text.p: The Electric Power Development Co Ltd said on Monday that it started test operations of a one million kilowatt (kw) coal-fired thermal power plant in western Japan on Friday.
The plant in Matsuura, Nagasaki prefecture, is due to begin full commercial operations in July, a company spokeswoman said.
Electric Power already runs a one million kw coal-fired thermal power plant on the same complex, she said.
Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc also already operates a 700,000 kw coal-fired power plant on the same complex.
According to 1995 data, coal was the power source for about 13 percent of the electricity generated in Japan that year.
